LanguageData.PC_T1_Smelter.label: smart smelter (T1)
LanguageData.PC_T1_Smelter.description: A T1 powered bench operated by a colonist. Retains prototype recipes, skill and research requirements, and ingredient costs. Stops without power. No additional quality floor. Uses original artwork until custom four-direction textures are installed.
